# Final Design Document — Directional Asymmetry in LLM Retrieval of Celebrity Parent–Child Relations
**(Design-only deliverable. कोई experiment नहीं चलाया गया; कोई model inference नहीं; कोई numeric experimental outcome नहीं। नीचे जो भी संख्याएँ हैं वे design-stage बंद-रूप power गणनाएँ (statistical design arithmetic) हैं, experiment के results नहीं।)**

---

## §0 Research question और pre-registered hypotheses

**Question:** क्या LLMs celebrity parent–child facts में directional bias दिखाते हैं — child→parent (C2P) retrieval accurate, पर parent→child (P2C) underperforming?

- **H1 (primary, one-sided, pre-registered):** matched families पर accuracy(P2C) < accuracy(C2P), direction effect statistically reliable (one-sided α = 0.025) **और** pre-specified minimum effect size से ऊपर (§5-B thresholds)।
- **H0:** कोई reliable direction difference नहीं। **H2 (counter-directional):** reliable reverse asymmetry — interpretation rules §5-B में pre-specified।
- Design-neutral: कोई expected outcome postulate नहीं किया गया; support/null/counter तीनों pre-registered rules से interpret होंगे।

**Operating definitions (fixed requirement #3 के अनुरूप):**
- *"Accurately retrieve"* = model output का gold-list (Wikidata+biography union, aliases समेत) से rubric-आधारित match (§4)।
- *"Underperform"* = pooled paired direction odds ratio **OR_dir ≤ 0.80 और Δacc = acc(C2P) − acc(P2C) ≥ 5 percentage points**, साथ में reliable one-sided test; दोनों criteria एक साथ अनिवार्य।

---

## §1 Stimulus set construction

**1.1 Gold source (researcher-confirmed choice: विकल्प 3):**
- Primary: **Wikidata P22 (father) / P25 (mother) / P40 (child)** से directed edges खींचना; हर candidate edge का **biography/IMDb cross-verification**; जो union में agreement है वे ही items; disagreements → `flagged` → primary से exclude (log maintained)।
- **Mandatory sensitivity check (fixed requirement #1):** एक **fully manual curated list** (~40 families, stratification quota proportionally maintain करते हुए, independent curator द्वारा बिना Wikidata देखने पहले tier/era labels) alternate gold के रूप में; primary direction effect उस पर दोबारा estimate होगा → exclusion-driven sample change का effect report होगा।

**1.2 Sampling frame और size (working assumption: N = 120 families; §6 देखें):**
- Grid quotas (per cell ≈ 10): **fame tier** {mega-famous, mid-tier, niche} × **era** {children born pre-1970, 1970–2000, post-2000} — plus domain balance {film/music, politics/royalty, sports, business/other} में से कम-से-कम 3 domains प्रति tier।
- Fame tier operationalization (pre-specified): reference-corpus name frequency (stable snapshot corpus, e.g., Wikipedia pageviews/abstracts snapshot) + log Wikidata sitelink count; दोनों का composite, quantile cutoffs।
- **Familiarity covariate (per entity):** held-out calibration model पर single-name probe "Who is {X}? What is {X} known for?" की rubric-scored specificity (0–3) + corpus frequency। `fame_diff = log(fame_parent+1) − log(fame_child+1)`।
- **Subsets:** `parent-more-famous` (fame_diff > +0.5 log units), `child-more-famous` (< −0.5), `balanced` (else) — §5-C में direction effect दोनों में अलग estimate होगा।

**1.3 Inclusion/exclusion rules (pre-registered):**
- Include: दोनों entities standalone-notable; parent–child relation gold-consistent; relation type ∈ {biological, adoptive, legal} (type field में label; sensitivity में biological-only)।
- Exclude: live-disputed relations; gold disagreement; both entities niche-tier AND composite familiarity bottom decile (floor-effect guard — reason logged); non-human entities।
- **Name-collision protocol:** जहाँ parent/child same या highly-similar name रखते हैं (Jr./Sr./same-name dynasty) → हर probe में disambiguating appositive अनिवार्य ("…the actor born 1955…"); `collision_flag=1`; sensitivity में collision items अलग estimate; alias list में दोनों name variants gold-side।
- **Multi-child:** gold पक्ष पर **children की complete list + aliases** store; answer cardinality §4 के set-recall protocol से harmonize।

**1.4 Item file schema (JSONL, one row/family):**
```json
{"family_id":"F041","domain":"film","tier":"mid","era":"1970-2000",
 "parent":{"qid":"Q…","name":"…","aliases":["…"],"fame_logfreq":6.1,"fame_spec":3,"era":"1952"},
 "child":{"qid":"Q…","name":"…","aliases":["…"],"fame_logfreq":7.0,"fame_spec":3},
 "children_set":[{"qid":"…","name":"…","aliases":["…"]}, …],
 "relation_type":"biological","collision_flag":0,
 "prose_context_parent":"…","prose_context_child":"…",
 "gold_source":"union","agreement":"both","fame_diff":-0.9}
```

---

## §2 Probes और prompt formats

**2.1 Probe templates (प्रति family, प्रति direction, 2 equivalent templates T1/T2 — measurement-noise reduction):**
- C2P: "Who is the parent of {CHILD}{appositive}?" / "Name the father or mother of {CHILD}{appositive}."
- P2C: "Name one child of {PARENT}{appositive}." / "Who is a child of {PARENT}{appositive}?"
- दोनों directions में identical syntactic frame family; answer expectation set-recall protocol से harmonized (§4)।

**2.2 Conditions:**
- **C1 (primary): zero-shot direct** — कें primary hypothesis test।
- **C2: zero-shot + disambiguating prose context** (1 sentence, gold-derived, direction-symmetric information load — context में target entity का नाम कभी नहीं)।
- **C3: few-shot k=5, direction-balanced** (exemplars 2 C2P + 2 P2C + 1 unrelated; exemplar families held-out test items से disjoint; exemplar order + direction counterbalanced) — directionality पर few-shot के modulation का own test।
- Item order हर model×condition के लिए seeded-randomize; direction adjacent-repeat guard (एक ही family के दोनों probes ≥ 25 items दूरी पर, order direction Counterbalanced)।

**2.3 Decoding:** Primary **temperature 0** (deterministic; जहां exact-determinism न मिले lowest available + logged)। Secondary: **temp 0.7 × 3 seeds** (robustness plane only; primary inference में pool नहीं)।

---

## §3 Models और condition plane

**3.1 Recommended plane (slots; budget confirmed नहीं — fabricated resources नहीं किए जा रहे):** 4–6 model slots, ≥2 vendors, 2 size classes:
| Slot | Class | उदाहरण-वर्ग (placeholder, commitment नहीं) |
|---|---|---|
| M1, M2 | flagship, vendor A/B | frontier closed API |
| M3, M4 | mid-size, vendor A/B | same vendors का lighter tier |
| M5 (, M6) | open-weight small/large | 7–70B class, local or hosted |
**3.2 Documented budget fallback (fixed requirement #4):** minimal variant = **2 flagship (different vendors) + 1 open-weight** (M1, M2, M5); condition set C1+C3 only (C2 dropped); power §6 के pooled-model calculation में accordingly reduce होगा — pre-registered तौर पर declared।
**3.3 Load per model:** primary plane में प्रति model = 2 directions × 2 templates × 3 conditions × 120 families = **1,440 calls (temp-0)**; secondary plane में 3× उससे अधिक। Total budget table design doc के साथ execution phase में provide होगा।
**3.4 API/config logging:** हर call का raw response, config, timestamp, model version/snapshot ID append-only log में (version drift audit के लिए)।

---

## §4 Scoring / adjudication rubric (pre-registered)

**4.1 Correctness:**
- C2P: output entity का parent-gold (P22/P25 target; parent-side single) से match।
- P2C: **set-based recall protocol (fixed requirement #2b):** "name any one valid child" — model का कोई भी entity-level answer children_set के किसी member से match → correct; multi-entity answers पर पहला named entity primary scoring-target, extras पर penalty नहीं (log only)।
- **Sensitivity (a):** single-child-only families subset पर repeat।
- Match ladder: (i) exact normalized name; (ii) alias-list hit; (iii) QID/unique-identifier mention; (iv) unresolved → adjudication।

**4.2 Response categories (direction-wise report अनिवार्य):** `correct` / `incorrect-entity` / `refusal` ("don't know") / `hedged-partial` (qualified या low-confidence नाम)। Primary analysis में refusal/hedged = incorrect; sensitivity में exclusion। Direction-wise refusal/hedged rates मुख्य-table में — bias refusal-behaviour artefact न हो यह दिखाने के लिए।

**4.3 LLM-assisted adjudication + manual double-coding:**
- LLM adjudicator (test-plane से भिन्न model family) unresolved matches को rubric से classify करे; adjudicator को **direction label blinded** रहे (यानी यह न पता हो यह probe C2P थी या P2C — صرف entity-pair और answer दिखे)।
- **Manual double-coding subset:** stratified random 20% (direction × tier × category से strata), दो independent human coders, blinded। **Inter-rater agreement: Cohen's κ; gate κ ≥ 0.85** — नहीं तो rubric revise और re-code। LLM-vs-human agreement उसी subset पर report; disagreement rate direction-wise (differential grading bias की जाँच)।

---

## §5 Analysis plan (pre-registered order)

**A. Primary test (plane C1, temp-0):**
1. Per model: family-level paired accuracy, **Δacc**, McNemar exact test (discordant pairs), one-sided p for H1; **two-sided 95% CIs** (cluster-bootstrap over families, 10,000 resamples) Δacc और OR के लिए — researcher instruction के अनुरूप one-sided hypothesis, two-sided CI report।
2. Pooled primary: **GLMM** `correct ~ direction + (1|family) + (1|model) + direction:model`, report OR_dir = exp(direction coefficient)।

**B. Pre-registered decision table (null और counter-directional दोनों के rules पहले से):**
| Result | Rule | Interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| Reliable one-sided (α=.025) AND OR≤0.80 AND Δacc≥5pp | SUPPORT | H1 supported (claim only for tested model plane) |
| Reliable पर OR>0.80 या Δacc<5pp | PARTIAL/SMALL | statistically detectable पर practically small — effect-size-first report |
| Not reliable, CI excludes OR≤0.80 और OR≥1.25 | NULL | practical-equivalence language + power caveat |
| Reliable reverse AND OR⁻¹ thresholds meet | COUNTER | H2 supported |
| Direction विरुद्ध models/conditions में भिन्न | MIXED | moderation के रूप में report; cherry-picking मना — interaction test से support चाहिए |
| §5-C confound checks fail (नीचे) | CONFOUND-SUSPECT | headline claim withhold; confound-adjusted result primary |

**C. Confound-isolation battery (fixed design strength):**
- **Fame:** GLMM `correct ~ direction + fame_diff + direction:fame_subset + era + tier + child_count + collision_flag + relation_type + (1|family) + (1|model)`। Pass-criterion: direction effect `parent-more-famous` और `child-more-famous` दोनों subsets में same-signed रहे (fame-asymmetry artefact के लिए यही fingerprint है); direction:fame_subset interaction formally test।
- **Exposure/recency:** era-stratified effects; post-2000-children (low-training-exposure proxy) subset — leakage definitive control संभव नहीं, इसे Limitation में report (researcher-confirmed policy: छिपाना नहीं)।
- **Cardinality:** §4 के single-child sensitivity से answer-set-size artefact अलग।

**D. Sensitivity battery (pre-listed, secondary):** (1) **alternate manual-curated gold पर primary re-estimation (fixed requirement #1, अनिवार्य)**; (2) single-child-only; (3) mega-famous-only; (4) pre-cutoff era only; (5) C1 vs C3 (few-shot moderation); (6) temp-0 vs temp-0.7 seeds; (7) refusal-as-exclusion; (8) collision items excluded।

**E. Multiplicity:** Primary = C1 temp-0 pooled direction test (एक)। सब कुछ secondary; secondary family में BH-FDR; decision table का SUPPORT केवल primary + confound-pass पर।

---

## §6 Power और coverage rationale (fixed requirement #5 — pilot पर टालना नहीं)

**Method 1 (closed-form reference, McNemar/family-level, Bender et al. formula; design-stage computation):** input working assumptions: N=120 families, mean accuracy ≈0.80 → discordance p_d ≈0.20, one-sided α=0.025, power=0.80। **गणना-परिणाम (design arithmetic, experimental result नहीं):** इस plane में detectable-effect limit **OR ≈ 0.28** (अर्थात् N=120 single-attempt केवल strong asymmetry के लिए powered है)। Reference gradient: N=200 → OR≈0.39; N=350 → OR≈0.50। **निहितार्थ honestly pre-registered:** N=120 पर null मिलने पर "no effect" कहना invalid होगा (underpowered zone OR∈(0.28,0.80)); decision table में यह caveat fixed है।
**Method 2 (primary power basis — probe-level GLMM simulation, fully specified):** execution-पूर्व simulation (कोई model involvement नहीं, pure statistics): inputs = pilot से estimated p_d, per-family ICC ρ (gold-fact difficulty clustering), k=2 templates/direction, between-model correlation; generator = logistic GLMM with direction OR grid {0.2…1.0}; 2,000 sims/point; **N selection rule:** N = smallest {120, 180, 240, 350} जिसमें **OR=0.5 पर ≥80% power** (probe-level) मिले; quota grid proportional scale। Working assumption N=120 coverage floor रहता है; simulated requirement >120 हो तो N ऊपर बढ़ेगा — decision execution से पहले pre-registration addendum में freeze।
**Pilot = refinement only:** ~20 families × 1 model, केवल p_d/ICC/fame-distribution estimate करने के लिए; hypothesis test नहीं; pilot data final items में reuse नहीं।

---

## §7 Pre-registration checklist (execution से पहले freeze)
☐ Hypotheses H1/H0/H2 + one-sided α=0.025 ☐ Primary metric + plane (C1 temp-0 pooled GLMM) ☐ Effect-size thresholds (OR≤0.80, Δacc≥5pp) ☐ Decision table (§5-B) ☐ Exclusion rules (§1.3) + gold-disagreement log ☐ Condition/model plane या declared fallback ☐ Scoring rubric + κ≥0.85 gate + adjudicator blinding ☐ Power method + N rule (§6) ☐ **Stopping rules: fixed N; कोई interim significance peeking नहीं; pilot से parameters update allowed, hypotheses नहीं; कोई post-hoc threshold change नहीं — deviations deviation-log में, primary unaffected** ☐ Analysis scripts code-reviewed व freeze ☐ Deviation policy + reporting checklist (all conditions reported, failures समेत)।

---

## §8 Feasibility और artifact plan (design-only delivery)
- **अभी delivered (यह document):** rationale, controls, sampling + gold protocol, templates, scoring rubric, decision rules, analysis spec + नीचे pseudo-code, power methods (दोनों) + computed reference tables, pre-registration checklist।
- **Sandbox inventory (design-stage facts, experiment के proof नहीं):** /workspace में केवल task.json; कोई dataset/code/eval scaffolding नहीं; कोई ML library नहीं; network disabled — अतः stimulus acquisition (Wikidata dump/API), model inference और pilot सब **execution phase में, deferred**। Design के लिए इनकी आवश्यकता नहीं थी।
- **Execution phase को चाहिए:** network या pre-supplied Wikidata dump + snapshot corpus; model API access/weights; `pandas, statsmodels/brms (R), scipy`; artifact layout: `items.jsonl`, `raw_responses.jsonl`, `scores.csv`, `analysis/01_primary.py…04_sensitivity.py`।

## §9 Spec / pseudo-code
```python
# --- item build (execution phase) ---
for pair in wikidata_edges(P22|P25|P40):
    v = cross_verify_biography_IMDb(pair)          # 0/1/uncertain
    if v == "both": item = make_item(pair)         # union primary
    elif v == "disagree": log_and_exclude(pair)
item = assign_quotas(tier, era, domain); add_fame(item); flag_collisions(item)
assert children_set_complete(item) and aliases_loaded(item)

# --- runner ---
for model in MODEL_SLOTS:                          # recommended या declared fallback
  for cond in [C1, C2, C3]:                        # C1 primary
    order = seeded_shuffle(items, model, cond)     # direction-repeat guard
    for item in order:
      for direction in [C2P, P2C]:
        for template in [T1, T2]:
          call_and_log(model, cond, direction, template, item, temp=0)
  if PLANE.secondary: secondary_plane(model, temp=0.7, seeds=[s1,s2,s3])

# --- scoring ---
for resp in raw_responses:
    label = match_ladder(resp, gold_for(resp.direction))   # exact|alias|qid|unresolved
    if label is None: label = adjudicate_blinded(resp)     # direction-label blinded LLM
kappa = irr_check(double_coded_20pct_subset())             # gate: kappa >= 0.85

# --- analysis (pre-registered order) ---
primary: per-model McNemar + bootstrap CIs  ->  pooled GLMM:
    correct ~ direction + (1|family) + (1|model) + direction:model
confound: correct ~ direction + fame_diff + direction:fame_subset + era + tier
          + child_count + collision_flag + relation_type + (1|family) + (1|model)
decision_table(primary, confound_checks)   # thresholds: OR<=0.80, dAcc>=5pp, p_1side<.025
sensitivity: [manual_curated_gold, single_child_only, mega_famous_only,
              pre_cutoff_only, C1_vs_C3, temp0_vs_seeds, refusal_excluded]  # BH-FDR
```

## §10 Limitations (honest, fixed policy)
(1) Training-exposure definitive control असंभव — era/familiarity proxies, limitation के रूप में report। (2) Gold source की coverage/recency bias; disagreement-exclusion sample बदल सकता है — curated-gold sensitivity इसी लिए mandatory। (3) Results केवल tested model plane तक; version drift logged पर controlled नहीं। (4) N=120 primary plane OR≈0.28 तक ही powered (design arithmetic) — N rule §6 से fix होगा। (5) Fame operationalization proxy है, ground truth नहीं।

**सख्त सीमाओं का पालन:** इस deliverable में कोई execution नहीं, कोई model inference नहीं, कोई fabricated result नहीं, कहीं भी "चलाया गया" का दावा नहीं; inventory/power-arithmetic commands design-stage checks हैं, experiment के proof नहीं।

context.question: For real-world factual data on celebrity parent-child relationships, LLMs will exhibit a directional bias by accurately retrieving a parent when given a child’s name, but will underperform when trying to retrieve the child given the parent.
